knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says water-use restrictions apply and that water must not be used where a restriction applies. Using the hose anyway (option 0) and ignoring the restriction (option 2) breach it, so the correct action is to use a method the restriction allows and inform the customer.
The lesson says to switch equipment off when not in use and not to leave a machine running between rooms. A running floor machine (option 0) and the highest setting (option 2) both waste energy.
The water use section says to use a bucket method for most cleaning and to change the water when it becomes soiled.

practicalCriteria: Learner checks a supplied site for water-use restrictions and the approved discharge route before using water.
Learner uses a bucket method and trigger spray with the minimum water that does the job, and changes soiled water rather than reusing it across zones.
Learner switches a machine off when moving between rooms and sets it to the lowest effective setting.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of any water-use restriction on site and the method used
Equipment fault record for any item using unusual energy or water
stopWorkCriteria: Learner uses water where a restriction applies
Learner bypasses a safety device to save energy
Learner reduces a rinse step that the label requires
